note: Helena-Lewis and Clark National Forest campground (Rocky Mountain Ranger District), ~18 mi west of Choteau on the South Fork Teton River: 6 mi north on US 89, then 23 mi northwest on County Road 144 (Canyon Road). Fishing and hiking access. Grizzly country - mandatory food storage. --Claude
